title: Simon-normalized Hausdorff measure of a Lipschitz image (Simon 2.1.8(i), inequality)
statement: Let X and Y be metric spaces with their Borel σ-algebras, m ≥ 0 a real number, and 𝓗^m := Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal m = (ω_m/2^m)·μH[m] (on X and on Y). Let E ⊆ X be an arbitrary set (no measurability assumed), K ∈ ℝ≥0, and f : X → Y K-Lipschitz on E (LipschitzOnWith K f E). Then 𝓗^m(f(E)) ≤ K^m·𝓗^m(E) in [0,∞], where K^m is the extended-real power (ENNReal.rpow).
lean_statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] [MetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] (m : ℝ) (E : Set X) (f : X → Y) (K : ℝ≥0), 0 ≤ m → LipschitzOnWith K f E → Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal m (f '' E) ≤ (K : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * Chapter01.simonHausdorffMeasureReal m E
